name: champ-pos-module1
description: CHAMP Burger POS + Inventory — monorepo root. Orchestrates server/ and client/, each of which stays independently installable/runnable on its own (see their own package.json + README).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
